text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Who will emerge victorious from this fierce battle!
Around the corner and into the final stretch――

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She surges, she surges, bursting through the pack with a red ribbon!
The winner is—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday!!
She captures the Takarazuka Kinen in brilliant fashion!!
(Waaaaaaaaaahhhhh!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa!
Who said this wasn't enough?!
That was insanely hype!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, what an insaaane race!!
I cheered so hard my throat went hoarse!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
My heart is pounding like crazy!
Could this be—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Marvelouuus☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Well? Well?
Did it get you thrilled☆ and make your heart race★?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Races really are wonderful, aren't they☆
The world is still soooo full
of exciting things like this★
(WAAAHHH!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: ...Hk, haha... they got me.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Aah, so frustrating!!
Still—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. Thanks to her, I was able to run
without any of those useless doubts or frustrations—"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: —That race was so much fun!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Marvelouuuus☆
I'm back, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, were you watching? Were you watching, were you watching?!
Everyone after the race!
Both on the track and in the stands!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
It was packed to the brrrrim with marvelous feelings☆
Everyone received the marvelousness, didn't they★☆★
choice_data_list: Yeah. That's the fruit of all your running!
Yeah. It's all the fruit of your running!

text_block_list.text:
"Spreading Marvelousness through racing"...
Just as the Tenno Sho (Spring) confirmed, the World Marvelous-ification Project is proceeding smoothly.

If we keep running race after race like this,
it won't just be a dream to share Marvelous Sunday's
running with the entire world!
choice_data_list: Let's enter lots of races even after summer ends!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Agreed! ☆★☆
Just like in spring, I want everyone to see it!
Sooo...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Autumn), Japan Cup,
and the Arima Kinen!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Let's run aaall of the Fall Senior Triple Crown races!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm-hmm☆ And you know, surely by that time—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
No, maybe earlier than that?
I'm sure you'll figure it out.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
The true identity of that spark of excitement
I felt after the Tenno Sho (Spring)—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: It's not just about me spreading the Marvelous to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: I mean something even more wonderful than that☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text:
—When people encounter sublime entertainment,
they all lose their words.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ! Mom—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text: We merely stand in silence. For that is the truest, most honest reflection of what is in our hearts.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Did it touch your heart, Fuji?
Did your feelings sway along with the red ribbon, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"To stumble, to get hurt, yet rise again."
Simple, and precisely because it's the hardest wall to face,
so too does your heart continue to challenge it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...The doctors have pretty much given up on me for ages.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much time it takes.
No matter how much effort is spent.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: They said it would be difficult to return to the turf—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I see.
...And then?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
Yeah, and, ...that's why—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ――"Long live misfortune!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"When forsaken by Lady Luck and cast into the
world's lowest depths, all that remains is
hope. There are no seeds of anxiety left!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...That's why I'll run.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"There's no way out of this."
"There's no way they can pull that off"... Isn't the whole point to brilliantly defy expectations like that?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Now that's a true entertainer!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry. I know we just reunited,
but I have to go now, Mom."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: “—Next time you come to the stands, make sure you watch me looking my finest on the turf!”

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, let's do that.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text:
――"The fire that's closest kept
burns most of all."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Fuji... If anything, your eyes looked like
they were shining far brighter than before.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Locked in a cage of pain and hardship,
yet still struggling forward—
you right now are far more dazzling.

The brilliance connects, growing ever larger.
Giving rise to that very premonition—

My days working with Marvelous Sunday
toward the Tenno Sho (Autumn) have begun.
